<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex58032026-01-26-141843" status="unreviewed">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Text 3 : dbu ba lugs su grags pa'i sems bskyed brgyud pa la phyag 'tshal ba"/>
         Bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo || <rs type="deity">thub chen</rs> <rs type="deity">'jam dbyangs</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3720">klu bsgrub</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3702">'phags pa lha</rs>|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3725">zla ba grags pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7788">rigs pa'i khu byug</rs> dang|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8059">slob pa'i rdo rje <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5555"/>dgra las rnam par rgyal</rs>|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8060">rdo rje gdan pa</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8075">gnyis</rs> <note type="editorial">The “two rdo rje gdan pa” are also referred to elsewhere as “the che” and the chung.”</note> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8080">pu Na ya shri</rs>| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6393">ba ri lots+tsha</rs>| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4205">sa snying chen kun snying dang||</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3848">bsod nams rtse mo</rs> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6128">grags pa rgyal mtshan</rs> dang|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3892">sa skya paN chen <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5838"/>'gro mgon chos kyi rje</rs>|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8011">dus 'khor ba</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="">'jam dbyangs mkhon ston</rs> dang|| <rs type="person" ana="">byang chub sems dpa' chen po rin chen</rs> <lb n="15a4"/> <rs type="person" ana="">mgon</rs>|| smon 'jug sems bskyed rgyud la phyag 'tshal lo || </seg></TEI>
